up: Retrieve compounds from document CHEMBL5441456, including their ChEMBL IDs, preferred names, and canonical SMILES, without any additional filtering or limits.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.molecule_chembl_id AS cmid, md.pref_name AS name, cs.canonical_smiles AS smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5441456'
